title: Observatory
description: A fictional platform for turning observations into useful signals.
provenance: A fictional architecture authored for Fractal on 2026-09-09. It demonstrates a data pipeline with a shared external store, nested analysis and a proposed forecasting capability. No implementation claims are made.

boundaries.title: User device
boundaries.description: The browser runs outside the service's trust boundary.

boundaries.title: Private processing network
boundaries.description: Internal event processing is separate from the public ingestion and query surfaces.

boundaries.title: Managed storage provider
boundaries.description: Storage is supplied through a replaceable external provider.

boundaries.title: Read authority
boundaries.description: The query service reads archived data; processing owns writes.

scenes.title: From data to insight
scenes.description: Follow observations from the browser through processing and back as useful signals.

scenes.title: Inside the pipeline
scenes.description: Reveal enrichment, time windows and signal detection without losing the surrounding system.

scenes.title: Across the boundaries
scenes.description: Inspect the private processing network and the managed storage boundary around its immediate collaborators.

scenes.title: Looking ahead
scenes.description: Add forecasting to the existing analysis pipeline and preserve uncertainty with every result.
